title: Multiple customers report items arriving damaged or defective
situation: High volume of damaged/defective items with VIPs involved requires immediate triage to prevent churn and ensure proper compensation.

params.reply_en: We are sorry your item arrived damaged. We have arranged a free replacement to be sent to you immediately. Please keep the original packaging for pickup.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن وصول المنتج تالفًا. قمنا بترتيب بديل مجاني ليتم إرساله إليك فورًا. يرجى الاحتفاظ بالتغليف الأصلي.

actions.why: Standard resolution for damaged goods: apologize and offer replacement.

params.note: Cluster of 27 damaged/defective items. Check recent shipments for packaging failures or carrier damage.

actions.why: Investigate root cause of high damage rate.

reply_other.it: Ci scusiamo per l'articolo danneggiato. Abbiamo organizzato una sostituzione gratuita che verrà inviata immediatamente. Si prega di conservare l'imballaggio originale.
reply_other.fr: Nous sommes désolés que votre article soit arrivé endommagé. Nous avons organisé un remplacement gratuit qui sera envoyé immédiatement. Veuillez conserver l'emballage d'origine.
reply_other.pt: Pedimos desculpas pelo item danificado. Organizamos uma substituição gratuita que será enviada imediatamente. Por favor, mantenha a embalagem original.

alternatives.why: Some items may be faulty rather than damaged in transit, requiring a return/refund instead of reship.
Customers might be receiving incorrect products, leading to complaints about damage or defects.
